b8_catalog_binding.hash_payload: sorted lines of topology|canonical_trade_signature joined by newline; only the SHA256 is durable, never challenge identities
b8_catalog_binding.rule: B8 human catalog must regenerate transient witness 1 using this exact persisted B6D snapshot, generator, constraints, pinned SciPy/HiGHS implementation and zero objective, then match the witness-1 catalog signature-set SHA256 recorded in b7_lineage_audit.json before assignment. Any mismatch is operational RED.
b8_catalog_binding.witnesses_2_3_role: materially distinct robustness structures, each <=50% challenge overlap with every earlier witness

b8_if_pass.attrition: replacement voter receives identical 24-challenge slot; partial ballots from incomplete voter excluded and recorded
b8_if_pass.randomization: frozen seed; 6 challenges/topology/voter; exact 3/3 V9-left/right balance

boundary_theta_0p60.frozen_activation_rate: descriptive; no 80% gate at the decision boundary
boundary_theta_0p60.zero_nuisance_floor_check: theta_hat>=0.60 frequency must lie in the exact 99.9% Monte Carlo acceptance interval around Binomial(n=240,p=.60) floor probability

design.left_right_balance: exactly 3 V9-left and 3 V9-right within every voter x topology cell

frozen_inference.estimator: direct linear-probability intercept with centered V9-left/right covariate
frozen_inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down across exactly m=4 retained topologies
frozen_inference.reference_distribution: Student t with G-1 voter-cluster degrees of freedom

harmful_theta_0p45_grid: same 15 subset configurations, descriptive only because theta=0.50 is the monotone worst case within H0

player_dependence_stress.application: global per-player random effect shared across topology catalogs; sign is positive for a player on V9-favored side and negative on V1.7-favored side
player_dependence_stress.catalogs: three transient materially distinct Tier-C-feasible 240/topology MILP witnesses regenerated only from the persisted B6D snapshot; every later witness may overlap any earlier witness in at most 480 of 960 challenges; challenge/player identities are never durably written
player_dependence_stress.failure_meaning: STOP; any remedy is a separately declared amendment
player_dependence_stress.formal_safety_evaluation: player-dependence safety is gated separately for every witness x player-SD combination; witness averaging cannot mask an unsafe catalog structure

power_alternative_reason: 0.65 is prospectively separated from the 0.60 decision boundary and represents about two-thirds manager preference for V9 on true discordances; it was fixed before B7 simulation and before any V9 human outcomes.

power_gate.criterion: for every topology, one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound on activation probability >= 0.80
power_gate.scenario: all four retained topologies have true theta=0.65 under primary B5C joint nuisance model

primary_nuisance_model.direction_reason: B5C modeled choice of raw/V1.7-preferred side; on V9/V1.7 discordance, complementing outcome and side orientation preserves sigma_challenge, sigma_voter, and delta_left semantics.
primary_nuisance_model.full_process_calibration: for each draw and labeled theta, solve latent intercept so marginal P(choose V9), integrating challenge + voter effects and balanced left/right, equals labeled theta
primary_nuisance_model.replicate_usage: each draw used exactly 20 times over 10,000 replicates, with deterministic seed-shuffled order
primary_nuisance_model.source: exact 500 B5C crossed-bootstrap joint nuisance draws

safety_gate.configurations: all 15 nonempty subsets of the four retained topologies assigned theta=0.50, with remaining topologies theta=0.65
safety_gate.criterion: for every configuration under every model, one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on P(any theta=0.50 topology activates) <= 0.05

theta_min_role: minimum observed product-relevant edge / decision value; not the power alternative
